title: Qualify scientific completeness of the priority cohort
objective: Core research usefulness is independently assessed, with deficits blocking acceptance.
outcome: Assemble a 100-product review matrix. No unknown cell counts as supported. An implementer or model cannot approve its own scientific output. Failed cases remain visible and receive bounded follow-up PRs. R04/R05/R07/R08 are not issued as pass; the failed matrix is retained. Frozen cohorts.json is not edited. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Assemble a reviewable core matrix
commits.instructions: Produce one row per product with essential-field outcomes and links to examples/citations, plus per-domain totals. Expose every unsupported claim and conflict.
commits.verification: All 100 products reconcile to their source contexts and acceptance requirements; no unknown cell counts as supported.

commits.subject: Review high-impact semantics
commits.instructions: Have Astra independently check unit/grain/date/denominator/join evidence and route unresolved domain judgments to a named human research reviewer. Record exact accepted values.
commits.verification: An implementer or model cannot approve its own scientific output; failed cases remain visible and receive bounded follow-up PRs.

commits.subject: Issue the core qualification receipt
commits.instructions: Run the complete core checks on the accepted generation and record readiness, reviewer scope and remaining limits.
commits.verification: Only issue a pass when R04/R05/R07/R08 actually hold; otherwise retain the failed matrix and continue remediation.
